about: The public functions of llm-memory-calculator/src, BudSimulator/src, BudSimulator/apis and bud_component.py that name a model-shape key (kv_corpus.SHAPE_KEYS) but that the corpus harness (scripts/kv_corpus.py) does not run, each with the reason it is not a memory or capacity figure of a model config -- a FLOP or time estimate, a benchmark record, a network-bound route whose figure is measured through another path. tests/test_kv_gate.py fails on any public reader neither run by the harness nor named here, and on an entry here that names no reader, gives no reason, or that the harness does run.

entries.reason: the share of MoE tokens routed to an expert on the same device (a communication rate for the all-to-all time), from the expert count and expert-parallel degree it is given; a time or communication-rate estimate, not memory or capacity
